newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Gil-Robles urges end to Albania crisis.
newsitem.headline: Gil-Robles urges end to Albania crisis.

text.p: European Parliament President Jose-Maria Gil-Robles called on Wednesday for a swift resolution of the political crisis which has plunged Albania into a state of near anarchy.
Gil-Robles urged the leaders of nine national parliaments in Central and East European countries, meeting at the European Parliament in Brussels, to support his call.

"I invite you to join me in calling on the authorities and the different political factions to put an end to the clashes which have taken place over the last few days and cooperate in seeking a peaceful and democratic solution to the serious crisis facing this country," the Spanish European People's Party deputy said.
Gil-Robles said he hoped the Organisation for Security and Cooperation in Europe and the EU's Council of Ministers would act as mediators "if this should prove necessary".
The parliamentary leaders of the Baltic states and six other nations were in Brussels for two days of talks to discuss preparations for their accession to the EU.
Bulgaria, which is currently holding elections, was absent from the meeting.
